release_notes:
1. Fixed select_item double-firing on Quick View and product cards.
2. Implemented synchronous click debouncing in handleSelectItem before asynchronous product resolution.
3. Isolated Quick View selectors (.js-quick-view-iqit, data-link-action=quickview) from generic listing click listener.
4. Added single-instance adapter re-entrancy guard to prevent duplicate event listener bindings.
